title: The four solutions
subtitle: Alongside the services, four solutions run as defined builds. Each has a known shape, a short set of decisions, and a handover to your team.

cards.title: SharePoint intranet
cards.description: A defined build: site templates, navigation, news and permissions set in a fixed order, then handed to an owner on your side who can extend it without calling us.

cards.title: Data analytics in Power BI
cards.description: Power BI models built on your Dynamics 365, SharePoint, and SQL Server data. Row-level security is designed in, and the model is documented so your team can change it.

cards.title: Automated CRM deployment
cards.description: A templated Dynamics 365 Sales or Customer Service go-live, pre-configured and scripted. Your work is decisions, data, and testing.

cards.title: Financial management
cards.description: Business Central or Dynamics 365 Finance replaces accounting patched with spreadsheets. Chart of accounts, dimensions, and the month-end close get designed before you cut over.
